question: If the radius of a hemisphere is 13√3 cm, find its curved surface area.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a hemisphere is calculated directly using the formula 2πr².

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × (13√3)²

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × 169 × 3 = 1014π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1014π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 r = 13√3 cm
 Curved Surface Area = 2πr²

**Given:**

Radius of the hemisphere (r) = 13√3 cm

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a hemisphere = 2πr²

**Calculation:**

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × (13√3)²

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × (13² × (√3)²)

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × (169 × 3)

⇒ CSA = 2 × π × 507

⇒ CSA = 1014π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1014π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The total surface area includes both the curved surface and the flat circular base. Formula: TSA = 3πr²

Volume of a Hemisphere

The volume represents the total 3D space occupied by the hemisphere. Formula: Volume = (2 ÷ 3)πr³

Surface Area & Volume of a Complete Sphere

For a full sphere of radius r, Surface Area = 4πr² and Volume = (4 ÷ 3)πr³
